sections.title: Identification and habit
sections.text: The catalogue entry Crataegus refers to Crataegus monogyna, common hawthorn, rather than the whole genus. It is a thorny shrub or small tree native to Europe, North Africa and south-western Asia, often 4–8 m tall and sometimes near 10 m. Its leaves are deeply lobed.

sections.title: Flowers, fruit and seeds
sections.text: White flowers are grouped in corymbs; red fruits are used in jellies and infusions. The seeds contain toxic compounds and should not be eaten. The plate matches the lobed leaves, flowers and fruits with a single stone.
